reference.face_embedding: <512-d CLIP vector omitted in this copy>
notes: Aggregation of REAL observations only: no generated, in-painted or mirrored face; unobserved canonical pixels have coverage 0.
canonical_marking_mask is the PRIMARY identity evidence; face_embedding is an auxiliary descriptor.
mapper 'planar': 2D similarity warp onto a 256x320 frontal template (stand-in for the 3D head surface); 3/4 and profile far halves down-weighted.
Template sides are image sides of the frontal view: canonical image-left = horse's anatomical right.

support = sum(w * accepted_mask) / sum(w): weighted fraction of observations whose Phase-2 accepted mask covers the pixel; n_support = number of such frames (canonical_nsupport.png stores raw counts).

canonical_peaks are CANDIDATE marking locations: local maxima of support_s = gaussian(support, sigma=4.0) >= 0.02 (min distance 12 px, max 8), ranked by support_s, each backed by >= 1 accepted frame mask within 8 px (frames/n_support = frames with mask pixels in that radius); prob/coverage are reported only. They are not part of the mask, which requires prob > 0.5.
